item.description: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) have studied one of the most metal-poor galaxies known. item.description: Researchers say effects particularly felt in South America where levels plunged even as some areas had extreme rain Extreme global heat caused an unprecedented decline in the water levels of lakes, rivers and reservoirs around the world in 2023 and 2024, an international study has found. The analysis of global water systems, a collaboration led by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, found that the planet’s surface freshwater fell sharply during the two years, which were the hottest on record. item.title: Wave-like displays in animal groups may have evolved to deceive predators
item.description: Some of the most striking patterns in collective behavior emerge in the face of danger. When a predator approaches, some animal groups morph into a vision of pulsing waves. These patterns might be more than a side effect of group living; they could have evolved as a form of deception, argue Dr. Eduardo Sampaio and professor Iain Couzin of the Max Planck Institute of Animal Behavior (MPI-AB) and the University of Konstanz in a Perspectives piece published in Science. Fuente: Phys.org.
